rules.description: Three promotional cues, or two offer claims with a cue and a URL in one document
A four-word text sequence repeated at least six times in one document
Three URLs share a destination, retaining queries, with one occurrence nearest a promotional cue within 256 bytes on the same line
At least ten URLs occupy at least 35 percent of raw document bytes
A trimmed line of at least 24 bytes occurs three times in one document

patterns.expression: (?i)\b(click here|check here|generate here|clicking this button|download now|buy now|visit our|contact us|no human verification|no survey|guaranteed profit)\b
